status: Closed — capability-bound temporary commit lifecycle verified and published 2026-09-05; residual record-only receipt is separate
area: Framework temporary claim / governed commit facade
finding: framework-mode claim creates a valid path lock but no commit-addressable task record. The normal governed commit facade therefore rejects the minted temporary task id with ATM_TASK_NOT_FOUND, even when the source change is fully within the temporary lock.
expectedBehavior: Every supported temporary write capability must be consumable by the normal governed commit path, or framework-mode must expose an equivalently governed temporary-commit facade. A valid temporary claim must not require raw Git or a hook-bypass emergency lease merely to persist its own locked files.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-14 P0 pre-commit latency quickfix: framework-mode claim created ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-perf-hotfix for packages/cli/src/commands/hook/pre-commit/implementation.ts. node atm.mjs git commit --task ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-perf-hotfix was rejected with ATM_TASK_NOT_FOUND because no matching .atm/history/tasks record existed. The owner-authorized, path-bounded emergency commit 7e7573c5149a2f83e84b9424aee2ea4c00216718 was the only safe persistence route.
followUp: Implement a capability-bound temporary commit transaction that shares the normal sealed-bundle, attribution, receipt, and cleanup semantics without requiring a durable planning task. Add an end-to-end regression: temporary claim -> governed temporary commit -> exact path verification -> lock release, with no emergency permission.
